āsaṃ.p: [Ta+naṃ] (ti) CL=8 To them. Ta -  Look.

R:
asaṃ：အ-သံ （ပ） （အ+သတ်）
သူယုတ်မာ။အသန္တ
X: āsaṃ，指示代名词 ay / i（this / these）阴性f．复数p．属格
āsaṃ，指示代名词 ay / i（this / these）阴性f．复数p．与格
B:
āsaṃ：āsaṃ（ti）
အာသံ（တိ）
«ta+naṃ»
[တ+နံ]
DOP: 1 asa, asaṃ ind. [?], (according to cts) permanent, eternal ; A II 212, 14 (asa smī ti hoti sata smī ti hoti; Mp III 207, 14 : atthī ti asaṃ niccass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ sīdatī ti sataṃ aniccass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ) ≠ Vibh 392, 30 (Vibh-a 514, 18 : atthī ti asaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee asa; quoted Sadd 450, 15 : atthī ti asa); Sadd 450, 13 (asa iti avibhattikaṃ nāmikapadaṃ, ettha ca asa smī ti hotī ti pāḷī nidassanam); 634, 29 foll. (asa smī ti hotī ti ettha asa asmī ti chedo, nicco asmī ti attho).
āsaṃ pl. gen. of idaṃ qv .
NCP: ind. | asa.m permanent; eternal See also: asa
